# Milestone (ميلستون) — full brand facts

> Saudi brand of premium kitchen and home appliances. Founded 2024, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Slogan: "The Integration Art". Tagline: "Where Utility Meets Design".

## About
Founded in 2024 in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Milestone delivers premium kitchen and home appliances that unite modern design, enduring performance, smart technology and quality under one brand. Built-in appliances are planned to fit the kitchen cabinetry precisely; the brand calls this "The Integration Art".

## Appliance families
- Built-in ovens
- Hobs and cooking surfaces
- Hoods
- Refrigerators
- Microwaves
- Dishwashers
- Washing machines

Many appliances come in several glass and metal finishes, such as black, gray, gold and blue.

## Services
- Appliance selection consultation
- Kitchen outfitting and planning, so built-in appliances fit the cabinetry
- Certified professional installation
- Maintenance with genuine parts
- Official warranty and after-sales support
- Delivery to all cities in Saudi Arabia

## Where to buy
- Official online store: https://milestone.website (browse appliances, read specifications, Design Your Kitchen)
- Showroom and headquarters: Takhassusi St, King Abdullah Rd Intersection, Riyadh 12362, Saudi Arabia (https://maps.app.goo.gl/PqfWhZn8Yg6EwoTQ9)
- Showroom hours: Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Milestone?
Milestone (ميلستون) is a Saudi brand of premium kitchen and home appliances, founded in 2024 in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Its slogan is "The Integration Art".

### What appliances does Milestone sell?
Built-in and freestanding kitchen and home appliances: ovens, hobs, hoods, refrigerators, microwaves, dishwashers and washing machines.

### Where is the Milestone showroom?
Takhassusi St, King Abdullah Rd Intersection, Riyadh 12362, Saudi Arabia.

### What are the Milestone showroom opening hours?
Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

### Does Milestone deliver across Saudi Arabia?
Yes. Milestone delivers appliances to all cities and regions in Saudi Arabia. Delivery fees depend on the destination city and the order.

### Do Milestone appliances come with a warranty and installation?
Yes. Milestone provides an official warranty, certified professional installation, maintenance with genuine parts and after-sales support.

### Where can I buy Milestone appliances online?
At the official Milestone online store, milestone.website, where you can browse every appliance, read the specifications and design your kitchen.

### How can I contact Milestone?
Call or WhatsApp +966 53 988 3009, or email info@milestone.website.
